metadata.sandbox_policy: Each live test prepares a fresh Task 3 SampleProject sandbox and launches WwiseConsole only with WWISE_FIXTURE_PROJECT under WWISE_SANDBOX_ROOT.
metadata.source_immutability_hash: sha256 over mutation-bearing Wwise project files (*.wproj, *.wwu), plus source .wproj mtime
metadata.task: 7. Add destructive sandbox tests for project mutation groups

action: create an ActorMixer with a unique prefixed name
set Notes on the created object through ak.wwise.core.object.set
delete the created object through ak.wwise.core.object.delete

cleanup_expectations: no WAAPI_TASK7_SANDBOX_ object remains after successful test
expected_mutations: create disposable ActorMixer under sandbox Actor-Mixer Hierarchy

assertions: creation returns an id and readback by id returns matching id/name/type
set is followed by readback of Notes matching the unique value
delete is followed by readback by id returning an empty array
source project .wproj mtime and mutation-bearing project-file hash (*.wproj, *.wwu) are unchanged
cleanup: delete created object if still present
delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies

action: begin undo group, create disposable object, end group, call undo
begin second undo group, create disposable object, cancel group

cleanup_expectations: no WAAPI_TASK7_SANDBOX_ object remains after successful test

assertions: object exists after endGroup before undo
object readback by id is empty after undo
cancelGroup is followed by readback; if the object remains, blocker evidence is recorded and the disposable object is deleted explicitly
source project .wproj mtime and mutation-bearing project-file hash (*.wproj, *.wwu) are unchanged

blockers.reason: No redo URI is reflected in the local Wwise 2022.1 functions manifest, so redo behavior cannot be asserted without inventing an API.

Local WwiseConsole fixture can leave objects created after beginGroup in place after cancelGroup; the destructive test records readback evidence and deletes the disposable object explicitly if this occurs.

cleanup: delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies

action: create disposable SwitchContainer and Sound child
attempt addAssignment, verify getAssignments, then removeAssignment

cleanup_expectations: no WAAPI_TASK7_SANDBOX_ object remains after successful covered test
sandbox copy deleted on success or preserved only for failure evidence
expected_mutations: add/remove one switch container assignment when the fixture is accepted

assertions: if addAssignment succeeds, getAssignments contains the child/state pair
after removeAssignment, getAssignments no longer contains that pair
if Wwise rejects the fixture shape, blocker evidence records the WAAPI error without claiming coverage
source project .wproj mtime and mutation-bearing project-file hash (*.wproj, *.wwu) are unchanged

blockers.reason: Switch assignment requires a Wwise-accepted SwitchContainer/SwitchGroup relationship; local manifest does not expose a dedicated safe fixture builder. The live test records the concrete WAAPI error if this shape is rejected.

cleanup: delete created switch/audio hierarchy roots if present
delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies
